policyNote: The Reserve is funded from the creator's share of $AMPH pool fees, forwarded by hand and visible on-chain. It holds HYPE. Fund targets are in US dollars because auction houses invoice in fiat, so a bar can move when HYPE's price moves even though nothing has been spent. The allocation is studio policy, published for scrutiny, not an obligation to any holder.
